done.why: Many routes were blocked with 'not today' lines. The hooded figure duel never gave me a way to unmask it or pass it west.

about: A dreamlike underground cavern world. A dream tells you to seek an old man when you are worthy. You explore a mist-shrouded shadow land, a lake and an ocean shore, and you duel a hooded figure who mirrors you and spares you.

ending.what: None. I stalled in the duel with the hooded figure, who blocks the western exit.

moments.note: Mist turned me back from the west with an evocative line.
The shiny object in the lake slipped away and I ran out of air.
Shouting summoned the hooded figure and the glowing sword.
The figure was defenseless and its hood was within reach, but every hood command failed.
The figure recovered its strength before I could act.

wished: Know how to uncover the figure's face
Retrieve the shiny object in the lake
Get past the mist and the rock slides

lines.line: It lowers its sword, and its head with it, and waits.
lines.why: A strong moment, but I couldn't find the action it was inviting.

lines.line: The water has the look of a cold that would open your hands for you
lines.why: Atmospheric, and it hinted at leaving the lantern on the shore.

fun.why: The atmosphere was good, but I got stuck on the duel.

engagement.why: Intriguing setup, then repeated attacks went nowhere.

difficulty.why: The hood action was opaque, and many exits were blocked.

interestingness.why: The mirror duel and the mist are interesting ideas.
